title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (notes §9–10, 'déploiement' of a stratified space of type I, I a finite poset). The previous page encodes the deployed (unfolded) data of a stratified space. There is a disjoint union of strata Σ_* = ⊔Σ_i with a map Σ_* → I_M (a partition of type I). There is Σ_** = ⊔_{i<j} Σ_{ij}, with Σ_{ii} = Σ_i. Two structure maps go out of Σ_**: a 'but' map b, locally a closed immersion (Σ_{ij} as a boundary/corner piece of the deployed j-stratum), and a 'source' map s, which is a fibration (Σ_{ij} → Σ_i is the link bundle). There is also a unit i : Σ_* → Σ_**. Altogether this is the nerve-level data of a category object in spaces lying over the poset I.

This page adds three things.
(1) A composition Σ_{ij} ×_{Σ_j} Σ_{jk} → Σ_{ik}.
(2) An axiom: the higher pieces Σ_{i0…in}, indexed by flags i0<…<in, are the iterated fibre products Σ_{i0i1} ×_{Σ_{i1}} … ×_{Σ_{i_{n-1}}} Σ_{i_{n-1}i_n}. This is a Segal-type condition.
(3) Compatibility with units and associativity.
The margin spells out the same thing: Σ^{(2)} → I^{(2)} = {i≤j≤k}, points x_{i0} ≤ … ≤ x_{in} over points of I. Conclusion: data Σ satisfying (3) is equivalent to a category M internal to topological spaces (he says 'enrichie'), with object space Σ_M, equipped with a functor Σ_M → I_M to the poset. In modern terms, the 'unzipped' stratified space is a strict topological category over I whose morphism spaces are the link bundles: a strict model of the exit-path category.

He then announces the inverse construction. From such data he will rebuild a stratified space of type I using only condition (1), plus a weak form of (2): the face maps Σ_{i0…in} → Σ_{i0…î_p…in} (p ≠ n) are embeddings, i.e. corner inclusions. He notes in passing what happens without this (garbled). The gluing pieces are indexed by pairs of flags d ⊂ d', with d determined inside d' by its complement; for d' = {i0,…,in} there are 2^n choices.

The next page shows why 2^n is right. Such d correspond to chains of nonempty initial segments d1 ⊂ … ⊂ d_{p+1} = d', each strict in the next. Each chain yields projections Σ_{d'} → Σ_{d_p} → … → Σ_{d1}, and one takes their simultaneous (iterated) mapping cylinder C_{Σ,d,d'}. The space is reassembled from these cylinders along natural transition maps. This is the classical 'stratified space = gluing of iterated mapping cylinders of link bundles' picture (Thom–Mather / Verona style), organised combinatorially by the flag (subdivision) category of I.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. One terminology slip: what is described is a category internal to Top (the objects form the space Σ_*), not a category enriched in spaces. 'Catégorie enrichie' should be read loosely.
The weakened condition, that faces deleting a non-last index are embeddings, is stated without proof that it suffices. The remark about what happens without it is too garbled to evaluate.
There is no actual proof on this page, only the announced construction; the gluing maps between the cylinders C_{Σ,d,d'} are only taken up on the next page.

ideas.what: Encoding the deployed data of a stratified space (strata, link bundles Σ_ij → Σ_i, corner immersions into Σ_j) as a topological category over the poset I, with composition Σ_ij ×_{Σ_j} Σ_jk → Σ_ik
ideas.modern_name: exit-path category / stratified homotopy type as a category (or Segal space) over the stratifying poset; 'unzip'/link data
ideas.usually_credited_to: MacPherson (unpublished, 1990s); Treumann 2009; Lurie, Higher Algebra App. A (2012); Ayala–Francis–Tanaka 2017 (unzipping, links); Barwick–Glasman–Haine (exodromy)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5 sketches the 'déploiement' and dévissage of stratified structures in words, but not (to my knowledge) this categorical / Segal formulation

ideas.what: Higher pieces Σ_{i0…in} as iterated fibre products over intermediate strata
ideas.modern_name: Segal condition; nerve of an internal category over I
ideas.usually_credited_to: Segal 1968/74 (for the condition); stratified version AFT, Haine, Douteau

ideas.what: Reconstruction of the stratified space by gluing simultaneous mapping cylinders of the projections Σ_{d'} → Σ_{d_p} → … → Σ_{d_1}, indexed by pairs of flags d ⊂ d' (2^n per flag of length n)
ideas.modern_name: iterated mapping cylinder / homotopy-link reconstruction; realization over the subdivision of I; 'zipping' inverse to unzipping
ideas.usually_credited_to: Thom, Mather (control data); Verona 1984 (abstract stratified sets); Quinn 1988 (homotopically stratified sets); Ayala–Francis–Tanaka
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5 states an equivalence between stratified spaces and their 'déploiement' informally

ideas.what: Weak hypothesis that face maps deleting a non-terminal index are embeddings suffices for the reconstruction
ideas.modern_name: corner-inclusion condition for manifolds with corners / unzipped stratified spaces
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ayala–Francis–Tanaka (conically smooth unzips are manifolds with corners)

missed.claim: Grothendieck (1981–82) recasts the unfolded data of a stratified space as a category object in spaces over the stratifying poset I, with a Segal condition on flags. The morphism spaces are the link bundles and composition is concatenation through intermediate strata. This is essentially a strict, point-set version of the exit-path category over I, a decade before MacPherson's exit paths and almost 30 years before Treumann/Lurie/AFT.
missed.quote: Donc la donnée de Σ satisfaisant (3) équivaut : celle d'une catégorie enrichie M, au dessus de la catégorie I_M : Σ_M → I_M
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Gives an early, explicit strict model (topological category with fibration/immersion structure maps) of the stratified homotopy hypothesis. It could serve as a rigid comparison model in work on exodromy and stratified homotopy theory (Haine, Douteau–Waas, AFT).

missed.claim: Inverse construction: rebuilding a stratified space from the category over I by gluing simultaneous mapping cylinders indexed by pairs of flags d ⊂ d'. Only the weak embedding condition on faces is needed. This is announced and only begun, with no proof of equivalence.
missed.quote: je vais construire un espace stratifié de type I, utilisant en fait (1), la condition (2) n'intervenant que sous la forme plus faible que Σ_{i0…in} → Σ_{i0…î_p…in} (p≠n) soit un plongement
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Recording the minimal hypotheses for a 'zipping' functor is directly relevant to AFT-style equivalences between unzipped and conically stratified spaces. The 2^n flag-pair combinatorics gives an explicit cubical gluing model.

deep.surprise_reason: The ideas match later developments (exit-path categories, Segal conditions over the stratifying poset, unzipping/zipping via mapping cylinders) that are credited to others decades later. Grothendieck's own published trace is only the informal sketch in Esquisse §5. The explicit category-over-I formulation is a notable unpublished anticipation, but the underlying gluing of mapping cylinders is classical (Thom–Mather, Verona).
transcription_corrections: The final sentence is probably: 'tels que d se déduit par complément dans d' (Pour d' = {i0,…,in}, [de longueur n — crossed out], il y a des 2^n choix possibles pour d)'.

The left-margin vertical note seems to begin '* revient à un objet simplicial [?] de M …' and later reads 'Σ^{(2)} = {x ∈ Σ_2 | …} → I^{(2)} = {i ≤ j ≤ k}' and '… Σ_{i0…in} = Σ_{i0 i1} ×_{Σ_{i1}} … (pour n=2) … Σ_{ij} ×_{Σ_j} Σ_{jk}'.
In the main text, 'Σ* multi-catégorie' is probably 'structure de catégorie' (or '… de Σ^* : … catégorie'); the reading 'multi-catégorie' is doubtful.
'utilisant en fait (1) [de (3) crossed out]' is correct. The insertion above 'la condition (2)' appears to read 'n'intervenant que…'.
